masses.name: The Most Holy Name of Jesus

propers.name: Collect
propers.text: Deus, qui Unigenitum Filium tuum constituisti humani generis Salvatorem, et Jesum vocari jussisti: concede propitius; ut, cujus sanctum nomen veneramur in terris, ejus quoque aspectu perfruamur in coelis. Per eumdem Dominum nostrum.

translations.text: O God, who didst appoint thy only begotten Son the Saviour of mankind, and commandest that his name should be called JESUS: mercifully grant, that we who venerate his holy name on earth, may also enjoy his sight in heaven. Thro'.

propers.name: Prayer over the Offerings
propers.text: Benedictio tua, clementissime Deus, qua omnis viget creatura, sanctificet, quaesumus, hoc sacrificium nostrum, quod ad gloriam nominis Filii tui Domini nostri Jesu Christi offerimus tibi: ut majestati tuae placere possit ad laudem, et nobis proficere ad salutem. Per eumdem Dominum.

translations.text: May thy blessing, O most merciful God, by which every creature is enlivened and subsists, sanctify this our sacrifice, which we offer thee in honour of the name of thy Son, our Lord Jesus Christ: that it may be acceptable to the praise of thy majesty, and available to our salvation. Thro' the same.

propers.name: Prayer after Communion
propers.text: Omnipotens aeterne Deus, qui creasti, et redemisti nos, respice propitius vota nostra: et sacrificium salutaris hostiae, quod in honorem nominis Filii tui Domini nostri Jesu Christi, majestati tuae obtulimus, placido et benigno vultu suscipere digneris; ut gratia tua nobis infusa, sub glorioso nomine Jesu, aeternae praedestinationis titulo gaudeamus nomina nostra scripta esse in coelis. Per eumdem Dominum nostrum.

translations.text: O almighty and eternal God, who didst both create and redeem us, mercifully hear our prayers, and vouchsafe, with a pleasing and kind countenance, to receive the sacrifice of this victim of our salvation, which we have offered to thy divine majesty, in honor of the name of thy Son, our Lord Jesus Christ; that thy grace being poured on us, thro' the glorious name of Jesus, as a pledge of our eternal predestination, we may rejoice that our names are written in heaven. Thro' the same.

masses.name: The Epiphany of the Lord

propers.name: Collect
propers.text: Deus, qui hodierna die Unigenitum tuum gentibus stella duce revelasti: concede propitius; ut, qui jam te ex fide cognovimus, usque ad contemplandam speciem tuae celsitudinis perducamur. Per eumdem Dominum.

translations.text: O God, who by the direction of a star didst this day manifest thy only Son to the Gentiles; mercifully grant that we, who now know thee by faith, may come at length to see the glory of thy Majesty. Thro' the same.

propers.name: Prayer over the Offerings
propers.text: Ecclesiae tuae, quaesumus Domine, dona propitius intuere: quibus non jam aurum, thus, et myrrha profertur; sed quod eisdem muneribus declaratur, immolatur et sumitur, Jesus Christus Filius tuus Dominus noster. Qui tecum vivit.

translations.text: Mercifully look down, O Lord, we beseech thee, on the offerings of thy church: among which gold, frankincense, and myrrh are no longer offered; but what was signified by those offerings is sacrificed and received, Jesus Christ, thy Son our Lord. Who liveth.

propers.name: Prayer after Communion
propers.text: Praesta, quaesumus omnipotens Deus: ut, quae solemni celebramus officio, purificatae mentis intelligentia consequamur. Per Dominum.

translations.text: Grant, we beseech thee, O Almighty God, that our minds may be so purified, as to understand what we celebrate on this great solemnity. Thro'.

masses.name: Saint Raymond of Penyafort, Priest

propers.name: Collect
propers.text: Deus, qui beatum Raymundum poenitentiae sacramenti insignem ministrum elegisti, et per maris undas mirabiliter traduxisti: concede; ut ejus intercessione dignos poenitentiae fructus facere, et ad aeternae salutis portum venire valeamus. Per Dominum.

translations.text: O God, who didst make blessed Raymond an excellent minister of the sacrament of penance, and didst miraculously conduct him through the waves of the sea; grant, by his intercession, that we may bring forth worthy fruits of penance, and be enabled to arrive at the port of eternal salvation. Thro'

masses.name: Saint Hilary, Bishop and Doctor of the Church

propers.name: Collect
propers.text: Deus, qui populo tuo aeternae salutis beatum Hilarium ministrum tribuisti: praesta, quaesumus; ut, quem Doctorem vitae habuimus in terris, intercessorem habere mereamur in coelis. Per Dominum.

propers.name: Prayer over the Offerings
propers.text: Sancti tui Hilarii nobis, Domine, pia non desit oratio: quae et munera nostra conciliet; et tuam nobis indulgentiam semper obtineat. Per Dominum.

propers.name: Prayer after Communion
propers.text: Ut nobis, Domine, tua sacrificia dent salutem: beatus Hilarius Confessor tuus, et Doctor egregius, precator accedat. Per Dominum.

masses.name: Saint Anthony, Abbot

propers.name: Collect
propers.text: Intercessio nos, quaesumus Domine, beati Antonii Abbatis commendet: ut, quod nostris meritis non valemus, ejus patrocinio assequamur. Per Dominum.

translations.text: May the intercession, O Lord, of the blessed Abbot N, recommend us to thee: that what we cannot hope for through our own merits, we may obtain by his prayers. Thro'.

propers.name: Prayer over the Offerings
propers.text: Sacris altaribus, Domine, hostias superpositas sanctus Antonius Abbas, quaesumus, in salutem nobis provenire deposcat. Per Dominum.

translations.text: May blessed N. the Abbot intercede for us, O Lord, that the offerings we have laid on thy altars, may avail us unto salvation. Thro'.

propers.name: Prayer after Communion
propers.text: Protegat nos, Domine, cum tui perceptione sacramenti, beatus Antonius Abbas, pro nobis intercedendo: ut et conversationis ejus experiamur insignia, et intercessionis percipiamus suffragia. Per Dominum.

translations.text: May the receiving of this sacrament, and the intercession of blessed N. the Abbot, protect us, O Lord; that we may both copy after the virtues of his life, and experience the help of his intercession. Thro'.

propers.name: Collect
propers.text: Deus misericordiarum Pater, per merita et intercessionem beati Hieronymi, quem orphanis adjutorem et patrem esse voluisti: concede; ut spiritum adoptionis, quo filii tui nominamur et sumus, fideliter custodiamus. Per Dominum.

translations.text: O God, the Father of mercies: grant, by the merits and intercession of blessed Jerome, whom thou wast pleased to make a helper and father to poor orphans, that we may faithfully preserve the spirit of adoption, by which we are called, and are in reality thy children Thro'.

propers.name: Prayer over the Offerings
propers.text: Clementissime Deus, qui veteri homine consumpto, novum secundum te in beato Hieronymo creare dignatus es: da per merita ipsius; ut nos pariter renovati, hanc placationis hostiam in odorem tibi suavissimum offeramus. Per Dominum.

translations.text: Most merciful God, who destroying the old man, didst vouchsafe to form a new one in blessed Jerome: grant, by his merits, that we also, putting on the new man, may offer thee this sacrifice of propitiation as a most sweet odour. Thro'.

propers.name: Prayer after Communion
propers.text: Angelorum pane refecti te, Domine, suppliciter deprecamur: ut qui annuam beati Hieronymi Confessoris tui memoriam celebrare gaudemus; ejusdem etiam et exemplum imitemur, et amplissimum in regno tuo praemium obtinere valeamus. Per Dominum.

translations.text: Being refreshed with the bread of angels, we humbly beseech thee, O Lord, that we who rejoice on the solemnity of blessed Jerome, thy Confessor, may also follow his example, and thereby obtain an ample reward in heaven Thro'.

propers.text: Deus, qui nos beati Georgii Martyris tui meritis et intercessione laetificas: concede propitius; ut qui tua per eum beneficia poscimus, dono tuae gratiae consequamur. Per Dominum.

translations.text: O God, who by the merits and prayers of blessed George, thy Martyr, fillest the hearts of thy people with joy mercifully grant, through his intercession, that the blessing we ask, we may happily obtain by means of thy grace. Thro'.

propers.name: Prayer over the Offerings

translations.text: Sanctify, O Lord, the offerings we have made; and, through the intercession of blessed George, thy Martyr, by them cleanse us from the stains of our sins. Thro'.

translations.text: We humbly beseech thee, O Almighty God, that those whom thou hast refreshed with thy sacraments, may, by the intercession of blessed George, thy Martyr, by a life well-pleasing to thee, worthily serve thee. Thro'.

propers.text: Da quaesumus omnipotens Deus: ut beati Paulini Confessoris tui, atque Pontificis veneranda solemnitas, et devotionem nobis augeat, et salutem. Per Dominum.

propers.name: Collect
propers.text: Deus, fidelium remunerator animarum, qui hunc diem beati Apollinaris Sacerdotis tui Martyrio consecrasti: tribue nobis, quaesumus, famulis tuis; ut cujus venerandam celebramus festivitatem, precibus ejus indulgentiam consequamur. Per Dominum.

translations.text: O God, the rewarder of thy faithful servants, who hast consecrated this day by the martyrdom of blessed Apolinaris, thy Bishop: grant we may obtain entire pardon for all our offences, by his prayers, whose memory we celebrate on this present festival. Thro'.

propers.name: Prayer over the Offerings
propers.text: Respice, Domine, propitius super haec munera, quae pro beati Sacerdotis et Martyris tui Apollinaris commemoratione deferimus, et pro nostris offensionibus immolamus. Per Dominum.

translations.text: Look favourably, O Lord, on these gifts which we offer in commemoration of blessed Apolinaris thy bishop and martyr, and for the expiation of our offences. Thro'.

propers.name: Prayer after Communion
propers.text: Tua sancta sumentes, quaesumus Domine, ut beati Apollinaris nos foveant continuata praesidia: quia non desinis propitius intueri, quos talibus auxiliis concesseris adjuvari. Per Dominum.

translations.text: Having received thy holy mysteries, we beseech thee, O Lord, that we may enjoy the continual protection of blessed Apolinaris, because thou never ceasest propitiously to regard those to whom thou hast granted the favour of such protection. Thro'.

propers.name: Collect
propers.text: Deus, qui beatum Ludovicum Confessorem tuum, de terreno regno ad coelestis regni gloriam transtulisti: ejus, quaesumus, meritis et intercessione, Regis regum Jesu Christi Filii tui facias nos esse consortes. Qui tecum vivit.

translations.text: O God, who removedst blessed Lewis thy confessor, from an earthly kingdom to the glory of an heavenly crown: grant, we beseech thee, by his virtues and prayers, that we may be received into the company of the King of kings, Jesus Christ thy only Son. Who.

propers.name: Prayer over the Offerings
propers.text: Praesta, quaesumus omnipotens Deus: ut sicut beatus Ludovicus Confessor tuus, spretis mundi oblectamentis, soli Regi Christo placere studuit, ita ejus oratio nos tibi reddat acceptos. Per eumdem Dominum.

translations.text: Grant, we beseech thee, O Almighty God, that as thy Confessor, blessed Lewis, despising all the delights of the world, studied only to please Christ his King; so also his prayers may render us acceptable to thee. Thro'.

propers.name: Prayer after Communion
propers.text: Deus, qui beatum Confessorem tuum Ludovicum mirificasti in terris, et gloriosum in coelis fecisti: eumdem, quaesumus, Ecclesiae tuae constitue defensorem. Per Dominum nostrum.

translations.text: O God, who didst render blessed Lewis, thy Confessor, illustrious on earth, and now glorious in heaven: appoint him, we beseech thee, the defender of thy church. Thro'.

masses.name: The Most Holy Name of Mary

propers.name: Collect
propers.text: Concede, quaesumus omnipotens Deus: ut fideles tui, qui sub sanctissimae virginis Mariae Nomine, et protectione laetantur; ejus pia intercessione, a cunctis malis liberentur in terris, et ad gaudia aeterna pervenire mereantur in coelis. Per Dominum.

translations.text: Grant, we beseech thee, O Almighty God, that thy faithful, who rejoice under the name and protection of the most blessed Virgin Mary, may, by her pious intercession, be delivered from all evils here on earth, and be brought to the eternal joys of heaven. Thro'.

propers.name: Prayer over the Offerings
propers.text: Tua, Domine, propitiatione, et beatae Mariae semper virginis intercessione, ad perpetuam, atque praesentem haec oblatio nobis proficiat prosperitatem et pacem. Per Dominum nostrum.

translations.text: May, O Lord, by thy own mercy, and the intercession of blessed Mary, ever a Virgin. this oblation procure us peace and happiness both in this life, and in that which is to come. Thro'.

propers.name: Prayer after Communion
propers.text: Sumptis, Domine, salutis nostrae subsidiis: da, quaesumus, beatae Mariae semper virginis patrociniis nos ubique protegi; in cujus veneratione haec tuae obtulimus majestati. Per Dominum.

translations.text: Having received, O Lord, what is to advance our salvation; grant we may always be protected by the patronage of blessed Mary, ever a Virgin, in whose honour we have offered this sacrifice to thy Majesty. Thro'.

First Sunday of Advent

propers.name: Collect
propers.text:
Da, quaesumus, omnipotens Deus, hanc tuis fidelibus voluntatem, ut,
Christo tuo venienti iustis operibus occurrentes, eius dexterae
sociati, regnum mereantur possidere caeleste. Per Dominum...

propers.name: Prayer over the Offerings
propers.text:
Suscipe, quaesumus, Domine, munera quae de tuis offerimus collata
beneficiis, et, quod nostrae devotioni concedis effici temporali, tuae
nobis fiat praemium redemptionis aeternae. Per Christum...

propers.name: Prayer after Communion
propers.text:
Prosint nobis, quaesumus, Domine, frequentata mysteria, quibus nos,
inter praetereuntia ambulantes, iam nunc instituis amare caelestia et
inhaerere mansuris. Per Christum...

masses.name: Second Sunday of Advent

propers.name: Collect
propers.text:
Omnipotens et misericors Deus, in tui occursum Filii festinantes nulla
opera terreni actus impediant, sed sapientiae caelestis eruditio nos
faciat eius esse consortes. Qui tecum...

propers.name: Prayer over the Offerings
propers.text:
Placare, Domine, quaesumus, nostrae precibus humilitatis et hostiis,
et, ubi nulla suppetunt suffragia meritorum, tuae nobis indulgentiae
succurre praesidiis. Per Christum...

translations.text: Be appeased, O Lord, we beseech you, by the prayers and offerings of our lowliness, and, where no support of merits is at hand, come to our aid with the defences of your forgiveness. Through Christ our Lord...

propers.name: Prayer after Communion
propers.text:
Repleti cibo spiritalis alimoniae, supplices te, Domine, deprecamur,
ut, huius participatione mysterii, doceas nos terrena sapienter
perpendere, et caelestibus inhaerere. Per Christum...

masses.name: Third Sunday of Advent

propers.name: Collect
propers.text:
Deus, qui conspicis populum tuum nativitatis dominicae festivitatem
fideliter exspectare, praesta, quaesumus, ut valeamus ad tantae salutis
gaudia pervenire, et ea votis sollemnibus alacri semper laetitia
celebrare. Per Dominum...

propers.name: Prayer over the Offerings
propers.text:
Devotionis nostrae tibi, Domine, quaesumus, hostia iugiter immoletur,
quae et sacri peragat instituta mysterii et salutare tuum nobis
potenter operetur. Per Christum...

translations.text: May the sacrifice of our devotion be offered to you unceasingly, O Lord, we beseech you, that it may both carry out what the holy mystery has appointed and work your salvation in us with power. Through Christ our Lord...

propers.name: Prayer after Communion
propers.text:
Tuam, Domine, clementiam imploramus, ut haec divina subsidia, a vitiis
expiatos, ad festa ventura nos praeparent. Per Christum...

translations.text: We implore, O Lord, thy mercy, that these divine helps having cleansed us from sin, may prepare us for the ensuing solemnity.

masses.name: Fourth Sunday of Advent

propers.name: Collect
propers.text:
Gratiam tuam, quaesumus, Domine, mentibus nostris infunde, ut qui,
Angelo nuntiante, Christi Filii tui incarnationem cognovimus, per
passionem eius et crucem ad resurrectionis gloriam perducamur. Per
Dominum...

translations.text: Pour forth, we beseech thee, O Lord, thy grace into our hearts, that we, who, by the message of an angel, have known the incarnation of thy Son, the Christ, may by his passion and cross, come to the glory of his resurrection. Thro'.

propers.name: Prayer over the Offerings
propers.text:
Altari tuo, Domine, superposita munera Spiritus ille sanctificet, qui
beatae Mariae viscera sua virtute replevit. Per Christum...

propers.name: Prayer after Communion
propers.text:
Sumpto pignore redemptionis aeternae, quaesumus, omnipotens Deus, ut
quanto magis dies salutiferae festivitatis accedit, tanto devotius
proficiamus ad Filii tui digne nativitatis mysterium celebrandum. Qui
vivit et regnat in saecula saeculorum.

propers.name: Entrance Antiphon
propers.text:
Hodie scietis, quia veniet Dominus, et salvabit nos, et mane
videbitis gloriam eius.

propers.name: Collect
propers.text:
Deus, qui nos redemptionis nostrae annua exspectatione laetificas,
praesta, ut Unigenitum tuum, quem laeti suscipimus Redemptorem,
venientem quoque Iudicem securi videre mereamur Dominum nostrum,
Iesum Christum. Qui tecum.

propers.name: Gospel Acclamation
propers.text:
Crastina die delebitur iniquitas terrae, et regnabit super nos
Salvator mundi.

propers.name: Prayer over the Offerings
propers.text:
Tanto nos, Domine, quaesumus, promptiore servitio haec praecurrere
concede sollemnia, quanto in his constare principium nostrae
redemptionis ostendis. Per Christum.

translations.text: Grant us, O Lord, we beseech you, to go before these solemnities with a service the readier as you show the beginning of our redemption to stand in them. Through Christ our Lord.

propers.name: Communion Antiphon
propers.text:
Revelabitur gloria Domini, et videbit omnis caro salutare Dei
nostri.

propers.name: Prayer after Communion
propers.text:
Da nobis, quaesumus, Domine, Unigeniti Filii tui recensita
nativitate vegetari, cuius caelesti mysterio pascimur et potamur.
Qui vivit et regnat in saecula saeculorum.

translations.text: Grant us, we beseech you, O Lord, to be quickened by the birth of your Only-Begotten Son recounted anew, by whose heavenly mystery we are fed and given drink. Who lives and reigns for ever and ever.

propers.name: Entrance Antiphon (alternative)
propers.text:
Gaudeamus omnes in Domino, quia Salvator noster natus est in mundo.
Hodie nobis de caelo pax vera descendit.

propers.name: Collect
propers.text:
Deus, qui hanc sacratissimam noctem veri luminis fecisti
illustratione clarescere, da, quaesumus, ut, cuius in terra mysteria
lucis agnovimus, eius quoque gaudiis perfruamur in caelo. Qui
tecum.

propers.name: Prayer over the Offerings
propers.text:
Grata tibi sit, Domine, quaesumus, hodiernae festivitatis oblatio,
ut, per haec sacrosancta commercia, in illius inveniamur forma, in
quo tecum est nostra substantia. Qui vivit et regnat in saecula
saeculorum.

translations.text: May the offering of this day's feast be pleasing to you, O Lord, we beseech you, that through these most holy exchanges we may be found in the likeness of him in whom our nature is with you. Who lives and reigns for ever and ever.

propers.incipit: Da nobis, quaesumus, Domine Deus noster
propers.name: Prayer after Communion
propers.text:
Da nobis, quaesumus, Domine Deus noster, ut, qui nativitatem
Redemptoris nostri frequentare gaudemus, dignis conversationibus ad
eius mereamur pervenire consortium. Qui vivit et regnat in saecula
saeculorum.

translations.text: Grant us, we beseech you, O Lord our God, that we who rejoice to keep the birth of our Redeemer may by a worthy manner of life deserve to come to fellowship with him. Who lives and reigns for ever and ever.

propers.name: Entrance Antiphon
propers.text:
Lux fulgebit hodie super nos, quia natus est nobis Dominus; et
vocabitur admirabilis, Deus, Princeps pacis, Pater futuri saeculi:
cuius regni non erit finis.

propers.name: Collect
propers.text:
Da, quaesumus, omnipotens Deus, ut dum nova incarnati Verbi tui luce
perfundimur, hoc in nostro resplendeat opere, quod per fidem fulget
in mente. Per Dominum.

translations.text: Grant, we beseech you, almighty God, that while we are bathed in the new light of your incarnate Word, that which shines by faith in our minds may blaze out in what we do. Through our Lord.

propers.name: Prayer over the Offerings
propers.text:
Munera nostra, quaesumus, Domine, nativitatis hodiernae mysteriis
apta proveniant, ut sicut homo genitus idem praefulsit et Deus, sic
nobis haec terrena substantia conferat quod divinum est. Per
Christum.

translations.text: May our gifts, we beseech you, O Lord, come forth fitted to the mysteries of this day's birth, that as he who was born man shone out as God also, so this earthly substance may confer on us what is divine. Through Christ our Lord.

propers.name: Communion Antiphon
propers.text:
Exsulta, filia Sion, lauda, filia Ierusalem: ecce Rex tuus veniet
sanctus et salvator mundi.

propers.incipit: Da nobis, Domine, Filii tui nativitatem
propers.name: Prayer after Communion
propers.text:
Da nobis, Domine, Filii tui nativitatem laeta devotione colentibus,
huius arcana mysterii et plena fide cognoscere, et pleniore
caritatis ardore diligere. Per Christum.

propers.name: Entrance Antiphon
propers.text:
Puer natus est nobis, et filius datus est nobis, cuius imperium
super humerum eius, et vocabitur nomen eius magni consilii Angelus.

propers.name: Collect
propers.text:
Deus, qui humanae substantiae dignitatem et mirabiliter condidisti,
et mirabilius reformasti, da, quaesumus, nobis eius divinitatis esse
consortes, qui humanitatis nostrae fieri dignatus est particeps. Qui
tecum.

translations.text: O God, who wonderfully created the dignity of human nature and still more wonderfully restored it, grant us, we beseech you, to be sharers in the godhead of him who deigned to become a partaker of our humanity. Who lives and reigns with you.

propers.name: Gospel Acclamation
propers.text:
Dies sanctificatus illuxit nobis: venite, gentes, et adorate
Dominum, quia hodie descendit lux magna super terram.

propers.name: Prayer over the Offerings
propers.text:
Oblatio tibi sit, Domine, hodiernae sollemnitatis accepta, qua et
nostrae reconciliationis processit perfecta placatio, et divini
cultus nobis est indita plenitudo. Per Christum.

translations.text: May the offering of this day's solemnity be acceptable to you, O Lord, by which both the perfect atonement of our reconciliation went forth and the fullness of divine worship was bestowed on us. Through Christ our Lord.

propers.name: Communion Antiphon
propers.text: Viderunt omnes fines terrae salutare Dei nostri.

propers.name: Prayer after Communion
propers.text:
Praesta, misericors Deus, ut natus hodie Salvator mundi, sicut
divinae nobis generationis est auctor, ita et immortalitatis sit
ipse largitor. Qui vivit et regnat in saecula saeculorum.

translations.text: Grant, merciful God, that as the Saviour of the world, born this day, is for us the author of the divine birth, so he may himself be the giver of immortality. Who lives and reigns for ever and ever.

masses.name: The Holy Family of Jesus, Mary, and Joseph

propers.name: Collect
propers.text:
Deus, qui praeclara nobis sanctae Familiae dignatus es exempla praebere,
concede propitius, ut, domesticis virtutibus caritatisque vinculis illam
sectantes, in laetitia domus tuae praemiis fruamur aeternis. Per
Dominum.

propers.name: Prayer over the Offerings
propers.text:
Hostiam tibi placationis offerimus, Domine, suppliciter deprecantes, ut,
Deiparae Virginis beatique Ioseph interveniente suffragio, familias
nostras in tua gratia firmiter et pace constituas. Per Christum.

propers.incipit: Deus noster in terris visus est
propers.name: Communion Antiphon
Prayer after Communion
propers.text:
Quos caelestibus reficis sacramentis, fac, clementissime Pater, sanctae
Familiae exempla iugiter imitari, ut, post aerumnas saeculi, eius
consortium consequamur aeternum. Per Christum.

masses.name: Solemnity of Mary, the Holy Mother of God

propers.name: Entrance Antiphon
propers.text:
Salve, sancta Parens, enixa puerpera Regem, qui caelum terramque regit
in saecula saeculorum.

propers.name: Entrance Antiphon (alternative)
propers.text:
Lux fulgebit hodie super nos, quia natus est nobis Dominus; et vocabitur
admirabilis, Deus, Princeps pacis, Pater futuri saeculi: cuius regni non
erit finis.

propers.name: Collect
propers.text:
Deus, qui salutis aeternae, beatae Mariae virginitate fecunda, humano
generi praemia praestitisti, tribue, quaesumus, ut ipsam pro nobis
intercedere sentiamus, per quam meruimus Filium tuum auctorem vitae
suscipere. Qui tecum.

translations.text: O God, who by the fruitful virginity of the blessed Mary, hast given mankind the rewards of eternal salvation: grant, we beseech thee, that we may experience her intercession, through whom we deserved to receive the Author of Life, our Lord Jesus Christ thy Son, who,

propers.name: Prayer over the Offerings
propers.text:
Deus, qui bona cuncta inchoas benignus et perficis, da nobis, de
sollemnitate sanctae Dei Genetricis laetantibus, sicut de initiis tuae
gratiae gloriamur ita de perfectione gaudere. Per Christum.

propers.name: Prayer after Communion
propers.text:
Sumpsimus, Domine, laeti sacramenta caelestia: praesta, quaesumus, ut ad
vitam nobis proficiant sempiternam, qui beatam semper Virginem Mariam
Filii tui Genetricem et Ecclesiae Matrem profiteri gloriamur. Per
Christum.

masses.name: Second Sunday after the Nativity

propers.incipit: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus, fidelium splendor animarum
propers.name: Collect
propers.text:
Omnipotens sempiterne Deus, fidelium splendor animarum, dignare mundum
gloria tua implere benignus, et cunctis populis appare per tui luminis
claritatem. Per Dominum.

propers.name: Prayer over the Offerings
propers.text:
Oblata, Domine, munera Unigeniti tui nativitate sanctifica, qua nobis et
via ostenditur veritatis, et regni caelestis vita promittitur. Per
Christum.

propers.incipit: Domine Deus noster, suppliciter te rogamus
propers.name: Prayer after Communion
propers.text:
Domine Deus noster, suppliciter te rogamus, ut, huius operatione
mysterii, vitia nostra purgentur, et iusta desideria compleantur. Per
Christum.

masses.name: The Epiphany of the Lord

propers.name: Collect
propers.text:
Corda nostra, quaesumus, Domine, tuae maiestatis splendor illustret,
quo mundi huius tenebras transire valeamus, et perveniamus ad
patriam claritatis aeternae. Per Dominum.

propers.name: Prayer over the Offerings
propers.text:
Suscipe, quaesumus, Domine, munera nostra pro apparitione Unigeniti
Filii tui et primitiis gentium dicata, ut et tibi celebretur
laudatio et nobis fiat aeterna salvatio. Per Christum.

propers.name: Prayer after Communion
propers.text:
Sacra alimonia renovati, tuam, Domine, misericordiam deprecamur, ut
semper in mentibus nostris tuae appareat stella iustitiae et noster
in tua sit confessione thesaurus. Per Christum.

propers.incipit: Deus, qui hodierna die Unigenitum tuum
propers.name: Collect
propers.text:
Deus, qui hodierna die Unigenitum tuum gentibus stella duce
revelasti, concede propitius, ut, qui iam te ex fide cognovimus,
usque ad contemplandam speciem tuae celsitudinis perducamur. Per
Dominum.

translations.text: O God, who on this day revealed your Only-Begotten to the nations by the leading of a star, grant in your kindness that we, who already know you by faith, may be brought through to gaze upon the beauty of your majesty. Through our Lord.

propers.name: Prayer over the Offerings
propers.text:
Ecclesiae tuae, quaesumus, Domine, dona propitius intuere, quibus
non iam aurum, thus et myrrha profertur, sed quod eisdem muneribus
declaratur, immolatur et sumitur, Iesus Christus. Qui vivit et
regnat in saecula saeculorum.

propers.name: Prayer after Communion
propers.text:
Caelesti lumine, quaesumus, Domine, semper et ubique nos praeveni,
ut mysterium, cuius nos participes esse voluisti, et puro cernamus
intuitu, et digno percipiamus affectu. Per Christum.

translations.text: Go before us always and everywhere, O Lord, we beseech you, with heavenly light, that the mystery in which you have willed us to share we may both discern with a clear gaze and receive with a worthy love. Through Christ our Lord.

masses.name: The Baptism of the Lord

propers.name: Collect
propers.text:
Omnipotens sempiterne Deus, qui Christum, in Iordane flumine baptizatum,
Spiritu Sancto super eum descendente, dilectum Filium tuum sollemniter
declarasti, concede filiis adoptionis tuae, ex aqua et Spiritu Sancto
renatis, ut in beneplacito tuo iugiter perseverent. Per Dominum.

propers.incipit: Deus, cuius Unigenitus in substantia nostrae carnis apparuit
propers.name: Collect
propers.text:
Deus, cuius Unigenitus in substantia nostrae carnis apparuit, praesta,
quaesumus, ut, per eum, quem similem nobis foris agnovimus, intus
reformari mereamur. Qui tecum.

propers.name: Prayer over the Offerings
propers.text:
Suscipe munera, Domine, in dilecti Filii tui revelatione delata, ut
fidelium tuorum oblatio in eius sacrificium transeat, qui mundi voluit
peccata miseratus abluere. Qui vivit et regnat in saecula saeculorum.

propers.name: Prayer after Communion
propers.text:
Sacro munere satiati, clementiam tuam, Domine, suppliciter exoramus, ut,
Unigenitum tuum fideliter audientes, filii tui vere nominemur et simus.
Per Christum.

propers.name: Collect
propers.text:
Concede nobis, omnipotens Deus, ut, per annua quadragesimalis
exercitia sacramenti, et ad intellegendum Christi proficiamus
arcanum, et effectus eius digna conversatione sectemur. Per
Dominum.

propers.name: Prayer over the Offerings
propers.text:
Fac nos, quaesumus, Domine, his muneribus offerendis convenienter
aptari, quibus ipsius venerabilis sacramenti celebramus exordium.
Per Christum.

translations.text: Make us, we beseech you, O Lord, rightly fitted for the offering of these gifts, by which we celebrate the beginning of that venerable sacrament. Through Christ our Lord.

propers.incipit: Non in solo pane vivit homo
propers.name: Communion Antiphon
Prayer after Communion
propers.text:
Caelesti pane refecti, quo fides alitur, spes provehitur et caritas
roboratur, quaesumus, Domine, ut ipsum, qui est panis vivus et verus,
esurire discamus, et in omni verbo, quod procedit de ore tuo, vivere
valeamus. Per Christum.

propers.name: Prayer over the People
propers.text:
Super populum tuum, Domine, quaesumus, benedictio copiosa descendat,
ut spes in tribulatione succrescat, virtus in tentatione firmetur,
aeterna redemptio tribuatur. Per Christum.

masses.name: Second Sunday of Lent

propers.incipit: Deus, qui nobis dilectum Filium tuum
propers.name: Collect
propers.text:
Deus, qui nobis dilectum Filium tuum audire praecepisti, verbo tuo
interius nos pascere digneris, ut, spiritali purificato intuitu,
gloriae tuae laetemur aspectu. Per Dominum.

propers.name: Prayer over the Offerings
propers.text:
Haec hostia, Domine, quaesumus, emundet nostra delicta, et ad
celebranda festa paschalia fidelium tuorum corpora mentesque
sanctificet. Per Christum.

propers.name: Prayer after Communion
propers.text:
Percipientes, Domine, gloriosa mysteria, gratias tibi referre
satagimus, quod, in terra positos, iam caelestium praestas esse
participes. Per Christum.

propers.name: Prayer over the People
propers.text:
Benedic, Domine, fideles tuos benedictione perpetua, et fac eos
Unigeniti tui Evangelio sic adhaerere, ut ad illam gloriam, cuius in
se speciem Apostolis ostendit, et suspirare iugiter et feliciter
valeant pervenire. Per Christum.

masses.name: Third Sunday of Lent

propers.name: Collect
propers.text:
Deus, omnium misericordiarum et totius bonitatis auctor, qui
peccatorum remedia in ieiuniis, orationibus et eleemosynis
demonstrasti, hanc humilitatis nostrae confessionem propitius
intuere, ut, qui inclinamur conscientia nostra, tua semper
misericordia sublevemur. Per Dominum.

propers.name: Prayer over the Offerings
propers.text:
His sacrificiis, Domine, concede placatus, ut, qui propriis oramus
absolvi delictis, fraterna dimittere studeamus. Per Christum.

propers.name: Prayer after Communion
propers.text:
Sumentes pignus caelestis arcani, et in terra positi iam superno pane
satiati, te, Domine, supplices deprecamur, ut, quod in nobis mysterio
geritur, opere impleatur. Per Christum.

propers.incipit: Rege, Domine, quaesumus, tuorum corda fidelium
propers.name: Prayer over the People
propers.text:
Rege, Domine, quaesumus, tuorum corda fidelium, et servis tuis hanc
gratiam largire propitius, ut in tui et proximi dilectione manentes
plenitudinem mandatorum tuorum adimpleant. Per Christum.

masses.name: Fourth Sunday of Lent

propers.name: Collect
propers.text:
Deus, qui per Verbum tuum humani generis reconciliationem mirabiliter
operaris, praesta, quaesumus, ut populus christianus prompta devotione
et alacri fide ad ventura sollemnia valeat festinare. Per Dominum.

propers.name: Prayer over the Offerings
propers.text:
Remedii sempiterni munera, Domine, laetantes offerimus, suppliciter
exorantes, ut eadem nos et fideliter venerari, et pro salute mundi
congruenter exhibere perficias. Per Christum.

propers.name: Prayer after Communion
propers.text:
Deus, qui illuminas omnem hominem venientem in hunc mundum, illumina,
quaesumus, corda nostra gratiae tuae splendore, ut digna ac placita
maiestati tuae cogitare semper, et te sincere diligere valeamus. Per
Christum.

propers.name: Prayer over the People
propers.text:
Tuere, Domine, supplices tuos, sustenta fragiles, et inter tenebras
mortalium ambulantes tua semper luce vivifica, atque a malis omnibus
clementer ereptos, ad summa bona pervenire concede. Per Christum.

translations.text: Guard those who entreat you, O Lord, uphold the frail, and give life always by your light to those walking amid the darkness of mortal men; and, snatched mercifully from every evil, grant them to come to the highest goods. Through Christ our Lord.

masses.name: Fifth Sunday of Lent

propers.name: Collect
propers.text:
Quaesumus, Domine Deus noster, ut in illa caritate, qua Filius tuus
diligens mundum morti se tradidit, inveniamur ipsi, te opitulante,
alacriter ambulantes. Per Dominum.

propers.name: Prayer over the Offerings
propers.text:
Exaudi nos, omnipotens Deus, et famulos tuos, quos fidei christianae
eruditionibus imbuisti, huius sacrificii tribuas operatione mundari.
Per Christum.

translations.text: Hear us, almighty God, and grant that your servants, whom you have steeped in the teachings of the Christian faith, may be made clean by the working of this sacrifice. Through Christ our Lord.

propers.incipit: Omnis qui vivit et credit in me
propers.name: Communion Antiphon
Prayer after Communion
propers.text:
Quaesumus, omnipotens Deus, ut inter eius membra semper numeremur,
cuius Corpori communicamus et Sanguini. Qui vivit et regnat in saecula
saeculorum.

propers.name: Prayer over the People
propers.text:
Benedic, Domine, plebem tuam, quae munus tuae miserationis exspectat,
et concede, ut, quod, te inspirante, desiderat, te largiente percipiat.
Per Christum.

propers.name: Antiphon at the Commemoration of the Lord's Entrance

propers.incipit: Fratres carissimi, postquam iam ab initio Quadragesimae
propers.name: Address before the Blessing of Branches
propers.text:
Fratres carissimi, postquam iam ab initio Quadragesimae corda nostra
paenitentia et operibus caritatis praeparavimus, hodierna die
congregamur, ut cum tota Ecclesia praeludamus paschale Domini nostri
mysterium, eius nempe passionem atque resurrectionem, ad quod
implendum ipse ingressus est civitatem suam Ierusalem. Quare cum omni
fide et devotione memoriam agentes huius salutiferi ingressus, sequamur
Dominum, ut, per gratiam consortes effecti crucis, partem habeamus
resurrectionis et vitae.

propers.name: Blessing of Branches
propers.text:
Omnipotens sempiterne Deus, hos palmites tua benedictione sanctifica,
ut nos, qui Christum Regem exsultando prosequimur, per ipsum valeamus
ad aeternam Ierusalem pervenire. Qui vivit et regnat in saecula
saeculorum.

propers.incipit: Auge fidem in te sperantium, Deus
propers.name: Blessing of Branches
propers.text:
Auge fidem in te sperantium, Deus, et supplicum preces clementer
exaudi, ut, qui hodie Christo triumphanti palmites exhibemus, in ipso
fructus tibi bonorum operum afferamus. Qui vivit et regnat in saecula
saeculorum.

propers.name: Gospel of the Lord's Entrance into Jerusalem

propers.incipit: Imitemur, fratres carissimi, turbas acclamantes Iesum
propers.name: Invitation to the Procession
propers.text:
Imitemur, fratres carissimi, turbas acclamantes Iesum, et procedamus
in pace.

propers.name: Procession Antiphon 1
propers.text:
Pueri Hebraeorum, portantes ramos olivarum, obviaverunt Domino,
clamantes et dicentes: Hosanna in excelsis.

propers.name: Procession Antiphon 2
propers.text:
Pueri Hebraeorum vestimenta prosternebant in via, et clamabant
dicentes: Hosanna filio David; benedictus, qui venit in nomine Domini.

propers.name: Hymn to Christ the King
propers.text:
Gloria, laus et honor tibi sit, rex Christe redemptor, cui puerile
decus prompsit Hosanna pium. Israel es tu rex, Davidis et inclita
proles, nomine qui in Domini, rex benedicte, venis. Coetus in excelsis
te laudat caelicus omnis, et mortalis homo, et cuncta creata simul.
Plebs Hebraea tibi cum palmis obvia venit; cum prece, voto, hymnis,
adsumus ecce tibi. Hi tibi passuro solvebant munia laudis; nos tibi
regnanti pangimus ecce melos. Hi placuere tibi, placeat devotio
nostra: rex bone, rex clemens, cui bona cuncta placent.

propers.name: Responsory at the Entrance into the Church
propers.text:
Ingrediente Domino in sanctam civitatem, Hebraeorum pueri,
resurrectionem vitae pronuntiantes, cum ramis palmarum: Hosanna,
clamabant, in excelsis. Cum audisset populus, quod Iesus veniret
Hierosolymam, exierunt obviam ei. Cum ramis.

propers.name: Entrance Antiphon
propers.text:
Ante sex dies sollemnis Paschae, quando venit Dominus in civitatem
Ierusalem, occurrerunt ei pueri: et in manibus portabant ramos
palmarum et clamabant voce magna, dicentes: Hosanna in excelsis:
Benedictus, qui venisti in multitudine misericordiae tuae. Attollite,
portae, capita vestra, et elevamini, portae aeternales, et introibit
rex gloriae. Quis est iste rex gloriae? Dominus virtutum ipse est rex
gloriae.

propers.incipit: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus, qui humano generi
propers.name: Collect
propers.text:
Omnipotens sempiterne Deus, qui humano generi, ad imitandum
humilitatis exemplum, Salvatorem nostrum carnem sumere, et crucem
subire fecisti, concede propitius, ut et patientiae ipsius habere
documenta et resurrectionis consortia mereamur. Qui tecum.

translations.text: O almighty and eternal God, who wouldst have our Saviour become man, and suffer on a cross, to give mankind an example of humility: mercifully grant, that we may improve by the example of his patience, and partake of his resurrection. Thro'.

propers.name: Prayer over the Offerings
propers.text:
Per Unigeniti tui passionem placatio tua nobis, Domine, sit propinqua,
quam, etsi nostris operibus non meremur, interveniente sacrificio
singulari, tua percipiamus miseratione praeventi. Per Christum.

propers.incipit: Pater, si non potest hic calix transire
propers.name: Communion Antiphon
Prayer after Communion
propers.text:
Sacro munere satiati, supplices te, Domine, deprecamur, ut, qui
fecisti nos morte Filii tui sperare quod credimus, facias nos, eodem
resurgente, pervenire quo tendimus. Per Christum.

propers.name: Prayer over the People
propers.text:
Respice, quaesumus, Domine, super hanc familiam tuam, pro qua Dominus
noster Iesus Christus non dubitavit manibus tradi nocentium, et crucis
subire tormentum. Qui vivit et regnat in saecula saeculorum.

translations.text: Look, we beseech you, O Lord, upon this your family, for which our Lord Jesus Christ did not hesitate to be given over into the hands of the wicked and to undergo the torment of the cross. Who lives and reigns for ever and ever.
